# Samverse: Sameer Gupta, Freelance WordPress Developer

> Samverse (samverse.space) is the portfolio and service site of Sameer Gupta, a freelance WordPress developer in India working with businesses and agencies since 2020. Services: WordPress website development, Elementor, WooCommerce stores, redesigns, speed optimization, SEO setup, maintenance, malware removal and migrations. Contact: sameergpt9719@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 74170 49145.

## Services
- [Online Stores](https://samverse.space/woocommerce-developer/): Hire a WooCommerce developer to build your online store on WordPress: products, payment gateways like Razorpay, shipping, and a fast mobile checkout.
- [Website Redesign](https://samverse.space/website-redesign/): Outdated, slow or not mobile-friendly? Get your website redesigned on WordPress with a modern look, faster speed and better SEO, without losing your Google rankings.
- [Speed Optimization](https://samverse.space/wordpress-speed-optimization/): Slow WordPress site? I improve loading speed and Core Web Vitals with caching, image optimization, code cleanup and hosting tuning, for better rankings and more conversions.
- [Website Maintenance](https://samverse.space/wordpress-maintenance/): Monthly WordPress maintenance: updates, backups, security monitoring, uptime checks and small content changes, so your website stays fast, secure and online.
- [Elementor Development](https://samverse.space/elementor-developer/): Experienced Elementor and Elementor Pro developer for custom page designs, theme builder templates, WooCommerce layouts and fixes, all pixel-accurate and responsive.
- [Figma to WordPress](https://samverse.space/figma-to-wordpress/): Convert Figma, Adobe XD or PSD designs into pixel-perfect, responsive WordPress websites with Elementor, built fast, clean and easy to edit.
- [Landing Pages](https://samverse.space/landing-page-design/): High-converting landing pages for Google Ads, Meta ads and campaigns. Fast, mobile-first, focused on one goal, with lead forms, WhatsApp and tracking set up.
- [WordPress SEO](https://samverse.space/wordpress-seo-services/): Technical and on-page SEO for WordPress: site structure, meta tags, schema markup, sitemaps, speed and Search Console setup, so Google can find and rank your pages.
- [Malware Removal & Security](https://samverse.space/wordpress-malware-removal/): Hacked WordPress site? Fast malware removal, cleanup of spam redirects and injected code, Google blacklist removal help and security hardening to stop reinfection.
- [Migration & Hosting](https://samverse.space/wordpress-migration/): Move your WordPress site to new hosting or a new domain with zero downtime and no lost SEO. Also Wix, HTML and other platforms migrated to WordPress.
